caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass goblet centered on a plain, light-colored background. The goblet features a wide, round bowl with vertical, rounded rectangular patterns around its exterior, a slender stem, and a broad circular base. The drawing is done in greyscale pencil, with varying shading used to indicate transparency, reflections, and contours of the glass. There are no additional objects or elements in the composition, and the background is left blank except for slight discoloration along the edges, giving the paper a slightly aged appearance.
title: Glass
